metadata.execution: Sequential isolated subprocesses on this computer; no parallel timed trials.
metadata.timing: perf_counter around the instrumented insertion loop, including cost counters; excludes input generation, warmup, process startup, final invariant validation and rendering.
metadata.deadline: End-to-end deadline per subprocess, including warmup and validation. A timeout is censored, not a runtime or a completed tree. Remaining trials in that group are not run.
metadata.sampling: One fixed permutation per size shared across strategies/trials; paired rotation seeds derived with SHA-256. SE is across trial seeds, conditional on that input.
metadata.limits: Python instrumentation timings, not bare algorithm timings. No general complexity or balance guarantee follows from these finite samples. No timing comparison is made against the optimized browser preview.

halving.name: Halving walk
halving.note: Try 1/2, 1/4, 1/8… and continue to the root after either outcome. Expected fewer than one rotation per insertion; ancestor work can be linear.

constant-half.name: Constant ½
constant-half.note: Rotate with probability 1/2 at every visited ancestor, continuing to the root. Both visits and rotations can grow with depth.

inverse-depth.name: Inverse depth
inverse-depth.note: Freeze initial insertion depth h and use 1/h at every decision. Sorted inputs produce a chain despite at most one expected rotation.

none.name: Plain BST
none.note: Ordinary leaf insertion. Ordered inputs can produce linear height and quadratic insertion work.

paper-zig.name: Paper · Zig
paper-zig.note: Continue upward with probability 1/2; otherwise promote the cursor once and stop.

paper-zigzag.name: Paper · ZigZag
paper-zigzag.note: Continue with probability 3/4. On stopping, a straight path promotes the parent once, a bent path promotes the cursor twice.

recount-root.name: Recount root lottery
recount-root.note: Exact random-BST shape distribution from empty, using transient full-tree counting. Linear scan work per insertion; quadratic total scans.

window-root.name: Window root lottery
window-root.note: Root lotteries within 64 actual node inspections by default. Never uses an incomplete count; no general logarithmic-depth guarantee.

hash-priority.name: Recomputed priority
hash-priority.note: Recompute SplitMix64 key/seed priorities for treap-style comparisons. No priority table or fresh insertion bits; finite hashes are not independent priorities.

random-level.name: Random level
random-level.note: Roll 64 fair bits and choose a depth from the previous observed priority interval. New minima reach the root; new maxima stay leaves. Stores only a count and two extrema; no balance guarantee.

random-level-v2.name: Random level v2
random-level-v2.note: Choose a repair level using the original 64-bit interval bands. Ordinary insertions perform at most two local rotations; strict new minima promote the leaf to the root. Expected fewer than three rotations per insertion from empty under iid uniform rolls. Ancestor walks can be long; no logarithmic-depth guarantee.
